items.text: Coupling 1: set digest on the replication plane (steady state ~24,000 enumerated items/min/peer -> ~200 bytes)
Coupling 2: batch GetContent for cold start (4000 RTT -> ~63 at 64/request)
Coupling 3: doorway forwards immutable + ETag cache headers on the blob-miss path (as the pantry-hit path already does)
Coupling 4: move the per-request authenticated flag out of the HTML so documents stop being no-store
Coupling 5: arrived bytes addressable before (or without) a per-item Kad publish
Batch-sizing falsifier: raise/retune BATCH_SIZE_FLOOR vs the ~2,666 ms/id x 12 s budget; unattempted -> 0 without verdicts rising means batch size was not the binding cost
Trust lever: the pricer only cheapens undeclared rows — widen the cheap corner via receiver-side content inference so declared divergent rows can be priced
Habit deltas: every lane habit a conjunction of performance + trust invariant; reach-enforced-everywhere asserts the absolute (unauthorized requester gets no bytes)
§8a follow-ups: validate content.reach at write time against the protocol enum + sweep/count already-written non-canonical reach rows (now dark)
